mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO task_evidence (task_id, device_code, type, source, attach_id, payload, seq, observed_at, reported_at, valid) VALUES (#{taskId}, #{deviceCode}, #{type}, #{source}, #{attachId}, #{payload}, #{seq}, #{observedAt}, #{reportedAt}, #{valid})
mapper.select: SELECT CAST(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(payload, '$.payload.lng')) AS DECIMAL(10, 6)) AS lng, CAST(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(payload, '$.payload.lat')) AS DECIMAL(10, 6)) AS lat, observed_at AS observedAt FROM task_evidence WHERE task_id = #{taskId} AND valid = 1 AND JSON_VALID(payload) AND JSON_TYPE(JSON_EXTRACT(payload, '$.payload.lng')) IN ('INTEGER', 'DOUBLE') AND JSON_TYPE(JSON_EXTRACT(payload, '$.payload.lat')) IN ('INTEGER', 'DOUBLE') ORDER BY observed_at, seq

SELECT COUNT(*) AS telemetry_count, MIN(observed_at) AS first_observed_at, MAX(observed_at) AS last_observed_at, MIN(CASE WHEN JSON_VALID(payload) THEN CAST(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(payload, '$.payload.battery')) AS DECIMAL(10, 2)) END) AS min_battery, MAX(CASE WHEN JSON_VALID(payload) THEN CAST(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(payload, '$.payload.alt')) AS DECIMAL(10, 2)) END) AS max_alt FROM task_evidence WHERE task_id = #{taskId} AND valid = 1
mapper.sql: valid = 1 AND JSON_VALID(payload) AND JSON_TYPE(JSON_EXTRACT(payload, '$.payload.lng')) IN ('INTEGER', 'DOUBLE') AND JSON_TYPE(JSON_EXTRACT(payload, '$.payload.lat')) IN ('INTEGER', 'DOUBLE')
